questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It is very difficult. The easy option is to get on-campus housing for both quarters. If you decide to go for off-campus housing, look for different Facebook groups where UC students are subleasing their rooms. Be aware of scammers, though

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: As mentioned above, be aware of scammers. Also, be ready to spend 1000-1500 USD a month
